note: What-if shocks. Each one is written and approved by a person before it can be sent. They are scenarios, never forecasts.

scenarios.title: What if energy prices jump?
scenarios.context: Energy prices can spike after a war or a supply cut, as they did in 2022.

scenarios.title: What if fuel rises?
scenarios.context: A shortage or a refinery outage can push pump prices up within weeks.

scenarios.title: What if a drought pushes food prices up?
scenarios.context: A poor harvest shows up in food prices over the following months.
